phrases.context: Use when an auto driver quotes an arbitrary high flat fare.

phrases.english: Will you go by the government meter?
phrases.hindi: क्या आप सरकारी मीटर से चलेंगे?
phrases.transliteration: Kya aap sarkari meter se chalenge?
phrases.audio_phonetic: Kya aap sur-kaa-ree mee-tur say chuh-leng-gay?
phrases.context: Ask before boarding an auto-rickshaw at railway stations or tourist spots.
To halt at your exact gate or destination.

phrases.english: Take me to Red Fort main entrance.
phrases.hindi: मुझे लाल किले के मुख्य प्रवेश द्वार पर ले चलिए।
phrases.transliteration: Mujhe Lal Qila ke mukhya pravesh dwar par le chaliye.
phrases.audio_phonetic: Moo-jhay Laal Kee-lay kay mookh-ya pruh-vaysh dwaar pur lay chuh-lee-ye
phrases.context: Ensures the driver drops you at Lahori Gate, not remote markets.

phrases.english: The TravelMate official rate is ₹180 to ₹220.
phrases.transliteration: TravelMate sarkari dar ek sau assi se do sau bees rupaye hai.
phrases.context: Show this card when quoted an inflated ₹500 fare.

phrases.english: Please give me an official receipt.
phrases.context: For paid parking, toll, or monument camera tickets.

phrases.english: No thank you, I do not need a tour guide.
phrases.hindi: नहीं धन्यवाद, मुझे गाइड की आवश्यकता नहीं है।
phrases.transliteration: Nahi dhanyavaad, mujhe guide ki aavashyakta nahi hai.
phrases.context: Polite firm refusal for aggressive street touts outside monuments.
Dial 112 or show to nearby security guards.

phrases.english: Where is the nearest Tourist Police Booth?
phrases.hindi: निकटतम टूरिस्ट पुलिस बूथ कहाँ है?
phrases.transliteration: Nikat-tam Tourist Police booth kahan hai?
phrases.audio_phonetic: Nik-ut-tum too-rist po-lees booth kuh-haan hai?
phrases.context: Active booths exist at Connaught Place, Paharganj, and IGI Airport.

phrases.hindi: कृपया मेरे लिए 112 पर कॉल कर दीजिए।
phrases.transliteration: Kripya mere liye 112 par call kar dijiye.
phrases.audio_phonetic: Krip-ya may-ray lee-ay 112 pur call kur dee-jee-ye
phrases.context: Ask local shopkeepers or metro staff in an emergency.

phrases.english: I need to contact my Embassy.
phrases.hindi: मुझे अपने दूतावास से संपर्क करना है।
phrases.transliteration: Mujhe apne dootavaas se sampark karna hai.
phrases.audio_phonetic: Moo-jhay up-nay doo-tuh-vaas say sum-purk kur-nuh hai
phrases.context: For passport loss or serious legal/consular matters.

phrases.english: Where can I safely deposit my shoes?
phrases.hindi: जूते सुरक्षित जमा करने का काउंटर कहाँ है?
phrases.transliteration: Joote surakshit jama karne ka counter kahan hai?
phrases.audio_phonetic: Joo-tay soo-ruk-shit juh-muh kur-nay kuh coun-tur kuh-haan hai?
phrases.context: Required at Gurudwara Bangla Sahib and Jama Masjid.

phrases.hindi: क्या यहाँ फोटो खींचने की अनुमति है?
phrases.transliteration: Kya yahan photo kheenchne ki anumati hai?
phrases.audio_phonetic: Kya yuh-haan pho-to kheenchnay kee uh-noo-muh-tee hai?
phrases.context: Prohibited inside Lotus Temple and Akshardham sanctum.
